**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Termination for convenience**

Section 11 locks Corio into a five-year initial term with automatic one-year renewals, and the only exits are uncured material breach or insolvency (11.2) and non-renewal at the end of a term (11.1). Corio has no convenience exit during the committed term, which is walk-away territory under the rule (no customer convenience right in a multi-year term). Commerce One has no mid-term convenience right either, so nothing needed cutting back on the Vendor side.

Remedy (validated, preferred position): new Section 11.4 giving Corio a convenience termination right on 30 days' written notice, without penalty or early-termination fee, with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees — relevant here because annual maintenance/support and MarketSite.net access fees are prepaid under Exhibit B. The comment offers 60 days' notice as a fallback.
